name: AddGatewayAuth

parameters.help_en: The name of the authentication
parameters.help_zh: 鉴权名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:
JWT
OIDC
IDaaS
ExternalAuthZ (custom authentication service)
parameters.help_zh:
鉴权类型：

JWT
OIDC
IDaaS
ExternalAuthZ（自建的鉴权服务）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Used when the authentication type is JWT or OIDC:
JWT: specifies the `iss` (issuer) claim of the JWT.
OIDC: specifies the `iss` (issuer) claim of the OIDC token
parameters.help_zh:
鉴权类型为JWT/OIDC时使用：

JWT：表示JWT claims 的iss(issuer)，即签发人。
OIDC：表示OIDC claims 的iss(issuer)，即签发人
parameters.name: issuer

parameters.help_en: The JWT public key. JSON format is supported
parameters.help_zh: JWT公钥，支持JSON格式
parameters.name: jwks

parameters.help_en:
The position of the JWT token. Valid values:
HEADER: transmitted in the HTTP header.

By default, the token to be verified is placed in the Authorization header with the Bearer prefix, such as Authorization: Bearer token
parameters.help_zh:
JWT Token类型：

HEADER：通过Header传输

要校验的Token参数信息，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：Authorization: Bearer token
parameters.name: token_position

parameters.help_en:
The location where the JWT token is stored.

By default, the token to be verified is placed in the Authorization header with the Bearer prefix, such as `Authorization: Bearer token`
parameters.help_zh:
JWT Token保存的位置。

要校验的Token参数信息，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：`Authorization: Bearer token`
parameters.name: token_name

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the JWT token.

By default, the token to be verified is placed in the Authorization header with the Bearer prefix, such as `Authorization: Bearer token`
parameters.help_zh:
JWT Token的前缀。

要校验的Token参数信息，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：`Authorization: Bearer token`
parameters.name: token_name_prefix

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to pass through the token
parameters.help_zh: 是否透传Token
parameters.name: token_pass

parameters.help_en:
The authorization blacklist and whitelist mode. Valid values:
true: whitelist mode. Hosts and paths in the list can be accessed without verification, while all others require verification.
false: blacklist mode. Hosts and paths in the list require verification, while all others can be accessed directly
parameters.help_zh:
授权黑白名单模式：

true：白名单模式（名单中的 hosts + paths 不需要校验即可访问，其余都需要校验）
false：黑名单模式（名单中的 hosts + paths 需要校验，其余可直接访问）
parameters.name: is_white

parameters.help_en: An unavailable parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter. By default, authentication is disabled after it is created
parameters.help_zh: 未开放参数，无需传递（鉴权创建后默认为关闭状态）
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The redirect URL after successful authorization. This parameter is used for OIDC and IDaaS. The value must be the same as the redirect URL configured in OIDC or IDaaS
parameters.help_zh: 授权成功后的重定向地址（OIDC/IDaaS使用，需要与OIDC/IDaaS中配置的重定向地址保持一致。）
parameters.name: redirect_url

parameters.help_en: The application ID registered in the service. This parameter is used for OIDC and IDaaS
parameters.help_zh: 服务注册的应用ID（OIDC/IDaaS使用）
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The application secret registered in the service. This parameter is used for OIDC and IDaaS
parameters.help_zh: 服务注册的应用Secret（OIDC/IDaaS使用）
parameters.name: client_secret

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the cookie. After authentication, the cookie is sent to the specified domain name to maintain the logon state.

For example, if you set the value to `Cookie-domain=a.example.com`, the cookie is sent to the `a.example.com` domain name. If you set the value to `Cookie-domain=.example.com`, the cookie is sent to all subdomains of `example.com`
parameters.help_zh:
Cookie的域名，认证通过后会将Cookie发送到指定的域名，保持登录状态。

例如：设置`Cookie-domain=a.example.com`，则Cookie会发送到域名`a.example.com`；设置`Cookie-domain=.example.com`，则Cookie会发送到`example.com`的所有子域名
parameters.name: cookie_domain

parameters.help_en: The OIDC authorization scopes. This parameter is used for OIDC
parameters.help_zh: OIDC授权作用域（OIDC使用）
parameters.name: scopes_list

parameters.help_en: The URL of the user logon page for the IDaaS instance. This parameter is used for IDaaS
parameters.help_zh: IDaaS实例用户登录页地址（IDaaS使用）
parameters.name: login_url

parameters.help_en: Used when the authentication type is JWT. Specifies the `sub` (subject) claim of the JWT. Make sure that the value of the `sub` field in the JWT payload is the same as the value configured here. If this parameter is not specified or is empty, the default value is the same as the value of the Issuer parameter
parameters.help_zh: 鉴权类型为JWT时使用；JWT claims 的sub（subject），即主体，请确保JWT的Payload中的sub字段的值与此处配置的值一致。如果该参数未设置或者为空，那么默认与Issuer参数设置的值一致
parameters.name: sub

fields.help_en: The headers allowed in the authentication request
fields.help_zh: 鉴权请求中允许携带的头部
fields.name: allow_request_headers

fields.help_en: The headers to retain in the authentication response
fields.help_zh: 鉴权响应中允许保留的头部
fields.name: allow_upstream_headers

fields.help_en: The maximum number of bytes for the request body
fields.name: body_max_bytes

fields.help_en:
The custom authentication mode. Valid values:
true: strict mode. If the authentication service is unavailable, such as when a connection fails to be established or a 5xx error is returned, the gateway rejects the client request.
false: loose mode. If the authentication service is unavailable, such as when a connection fails to be established or a 5xx error is returned, the gateway allows the client request
fields.help_zh:
自定义鉴权模式：

true：严格模式，当鉴权服务不可用时（鉴权服务建立连接失败或者返回5xx请求），网关拒绝客户端请求
false：宽松模式，当鉴权服务不可用时（鉴权服务建立连接失败或者返回5xx请求），网关放过客户端请求
fields.name: is_restrict

fields.help_en: The path of the authentication API provided by the authentication service. The API path must match the prefix
fields.help_zh: 鉴权服务提供的鉴权API的Path，API的Path需是前缀匹配
fields.name: prefix_path

fields.help_en: The ID of the authentication service
fields.name: service_id

fields.help_en: The timeout period of the authentication service. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 鉴权服务的超时时间，单位：秒
fields.name: timeout

fields.help_en: The header in the request message that contains the token. Common headers include Authorization and Cookie
fields.help_zh: Token处于请求报文中哪个Header中，常见的有Authorization和Cookie
fields.name: token_key

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to rematch the route after authentication
fields.help_zh: 是否在鉴权完成后重新匹配路由
fields.name: with_rematch_route

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to include the request body
fields.name: with_request_body

parameters.help_en: The custom authentication information
parameters.help_zh: 自定义鉴权信息
parameters.name: external_authz_json

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.help_zh: 网关唯一标识ID
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
The authorization resource mode. Valid values:
0: simple mode.
1: complex mode
parameters.help_zh:
授权资源模式：

0：简单模式
1：复杂模式
parameters.name: auth_resource_mode

parameters.example:
permissions:
  - not_rule:
      or_rules:
        rules:
        - and_rules:
            rules:
            - url_path:
                path:
                  ignore_case: false
                  prefix: /version
        - and_rules:
            rules:
            - url_path:
                path:
                  ignore_case: false
                  prefix: /header
parameters.help_en: The YAML configuration for the complex mode
parameters.help_zh: 复杂模式的YAML配置
parameters.name: auth_resource_config

fields.help_en: The name of the request header
fields.name: header_key

fields.help_en:
The matching condition. Valid values:
EQUAL: equal to.
NOT_EQUAL: not equal to.
EXIST: exists.
NOT_EXIST: does not exist.
INCLUDE: includes.
EXCLUDE: excludes.
PREFIX: prefix.
SUFFIX: suffix.
REGREX: regular expression
fields.help_zh:
匹配条件：

EQUAL：等于
NOT_EQUAL：不等于
EXIST：存在
NOT_EXIST：不存在
INCLUDE：包含
EXCLUDE：不包含
PREFIX：前缀
SUFFIX：后缀
REGREX：正则
fields.name: header_method

fields.help_en: The value of the request header
fields.name: header_value

fields.help_en: The request headers of the rule. This parameter is currently only used for custom authentication
fields.help_zh: 规则的请求头（当前仅供自定义鉴权使用）
fields.name: auth_resource_header_list

fields.help_en: The ID of the domain name in the rule
fields.name: domain_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the path is case-sensitive. This parameter is used when creating custom authentication. For other authentication types, case sensitivity is enabled by default. Valid values:
true: case-sensitive.
false: case-insensitive
fields.help_zh:
路径是否开启大小写敏感（创建自定义鉴权时使用，其他鉴权类型默认开启大小写敏感）

true：开启大小写敏感
false：关闭大小写敏感
fields.name: ignore_case

fields.help_en:
The matching type for the request path. Valid values:
EQUAL: exact match.
PRE: prefix match.
ERGULAR: regular expression match
fields.help_zh:
请求Path的匹配类型：

EQUAL：精确匹配
PRE：前缀匹配
ERGULAR：正则匹配
fields.name: match_type

fields.help_en: The matching path of the rule
fields.name: path

parameters.help_en: The list of authorization rules for authentication. Multiple rule conditions use the OR operator, and multiple matching items within a rule condition use the AND operator
parameters.help_zh: 鉴权的授权规则列表，多个规则条件之间是“或”关系，规则条件内的多个匹配项之间是“与”关系
parameters.name: auth_resource_list

parameters.help_en:
The language of the returned result. Valid values:
zh: Chinese. This is the default value.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

Code.description_en: The code synchronized with the Success parameter. If Success is true, Code is 200

Data.description_en: The ID of the created authentication

Success.description_en:
The request result. Valid values:
`true`: The request is successful.
`false`: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求结果，取值如下：
`true`：请求成功。
`false`：请求失败
